summary: Candidate is a distinct trace lifecycle termination micro_skill with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills cover data preparation (dataset filtering), UI interaction safety (control disabling), and trace metadata updates—none address trace finalization. Peer candidates (Trace Context Cleanup, Trace Metadata Update, Start Trace Session) are complementary trace management skills at the same layer but different methods (cleanup, metadata, initialization vs. termination). Candidate has clear support evidence from Debugging Roadmap and well-defined constraints/cautions for safe trace closure.
